# Audio frontend oracle

`features_oracle.json` is generated by `tool/audio_features_oracle.py` using
the pinned official LFM3-Audio feature extractor. It contains normalized
log-mel features of deterministic synthetic PCM only, with no recordings or
model weights. The tool records upstream source URL, hash and library versions.

The PCM formula shared by the generator and tests uses integer arithmetic and
exact powers-of-two scaling, avoiding platform-dependent waveform generation.
Cases cover silence, empty/short input and both sides of frame/hop boundaries.

`encoder_oracle.json` contains small synthetic Q4_0/F32 tensors and intermediate
outputs from the pinned official audio encoder graph. The tensor bytes are
deterministically generated, not copied from the checkpoint. It covers causal
convolution, GQA/RoPE, attention-window boundaries and the projector.
Regenerate with `python tool/audio_encoder_oracle.py`.

`encoder_stream_oracle.json` is generated in the same run using the official
encoder streaming method and the same synthetic weights. It stores outputs
and row counts per irregular chunk, including empty chunks and finalization.

`prompt_oracle.json` comes from the pinned official processor's ChatML template
for automatic, English and Japanese ASR. Regenerate with
`python tool/audio_prompt_oracle.py`.

`generation_oracle.json` contains deterministic synthetic generation tensors
and pinned official Depthformer/LiquidCodec outputs. It covers masked/partial
codebooks, every depth layer, logits, feedback, and batch/streamed waveforms
across the codec attention window. Regenerate with
`python tool/audio_generation_oracle.py` in the validation Python environment.

`tts_prompt_oracle.json` renders the pinned language GGUF's embedded ChatML
template for English/Japanese female and British English male instructions,
then appends the official TTS audio-start marker. Regenerate using
`python tool/audio_tts_prompt_oracle.py --gguf <language.gguf>
--gguf-python /path/to/llama.cpp/gguf-py`. The tool verifies the pinned file
hash and records the template hash; it does not store checkpoint weights.

`conversation_oracle.json` executes the pinned upstream `_generate` per-row
state machine with scripted text tokens/audio frames and zero embedding rows.
It covers six/twelve alternation, early text-end, EOS inside a speech burst,
mode reopening and turn termination. Its prompt is independently rendered from
the official processor template. No learned weights are included. Regenerate
with `python tool/audio_conversation_oracle.py` in the validation environment.

`live_oracle.json` runs the pinned upstream `transcribe_live` method with
scripted logits and synthetic encoder rows. It covers nonfinal suppression,
final markers/stops, token-cap closure and calls with no new audio rows. Source
URL/hash and Torch version are recorded. Regenerate with
`python tool/audio_live_oracle.py`; no checkpoint weights are used.
